entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Thank you for[n]everything yesterday.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Because of you, I've been able[n]to take a new step forward.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: No, not just me... but[n]Okumura Foods as well!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Speaking of which, I just[n]received word about Big Bang[n]Burger's new product.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Takakura-san said that it's[n]the jumping-off point for a[n]new-look Okumura Foods.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Not only is he thinking about the[n]business, but he wants to carry[n]out my father's will as well.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I was so happy to hear that.
You did great, Haru.
The future is bright.
Your feelings got through.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Thank you. And you've been there[n]the whole time, encouraging me...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Yes, I'm certain it will become[n]a truly wonderful company.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You think so? Thank goodness...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I need to keep working hard[n]too so I can open my café!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: By the way, Big Bang Burger's[n]new product is going to be[n]made available... today.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It's called the White Sea[n]Burger. It's a white patty[n]made entirely of seafood.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It would be excellent[n]if you could give it[n]a try, [fName]-kun.
Of course.
Sounds delicious.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I hear they're very confident[n]about it... If you don't mind,[n]I'd love to get your thoughts.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I hear they're very confident[n]about it... I hope it lives up[n]to your expectations.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: ...Oh my, look at the time.[n]I would love to talk more, but[n]I really should be going to bed.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Good night.
